references.shows: The side photo shows the bell stem above the leadpipe and the main tuning bow toward the bell.
Maker reference for the chosen instrument form and proportions.

silhouette: Slim horizontal leadpipe and compact valve block, with a flared bell on the forward axis.
features: Narrow leadpipe with a small cup mouthpiece
Main tuning bend and short valve slides
Bell taper flaring at the forward end
iconFeatures: Three aligned piston buttons and a slim leadpipe.
Upper bell branch and two shallow returns on either side of the valve block.
avoid: Overlapping tubes that hide the principal bends
Detached or offset mouthpiece and bell
notes: The neutral catalogue photo of the YTR-8335II guides the silhouette and visible tube routing. The illustration simplifies overlapping plumbing from the side.

geometry.view: Neutral catalogue side view in playing orientation
geometry.proportions: The long, narrow bell stem stays above the mouthpiece line. The small bell opening is about one fifth of the overall length.
geometry.partLayout: Run the leadpipe to the forward tuning bow and back toward the three pistons. The rear bow feeds the upper bell stem. Seat the short and long slide returns in the valve block.

documentedDimensions.value: 123 mm bell diameter and 11.65 mm bore
